row.title: Assign a new safety report identifier for a separate adverse event and link the earlier report in A.1.12
row.statement: When the same patient suffers a separate adverse event, the sender should assign a new (case) safety report unique identifier for the new case and represent the previous report for that patient in A.1.12 (Identification Number of the Report which is Linked to this Report).

Because there has not been a previous E2B/M2 electronic report, the identifiers in A.1.0.1 and A.1.10.2 are the same. The previous report from Company K, JP-K-001, for patient XX should be represented in A.1.12, Identification Number of the Report which is Linked to this Report.
